resources.string:
Linux terminal commands (persistent native session):
 :help full list of : commands (:load :vars :type :time :check :ocr :img :cd :ls ...)
 :ocr <image> print the text found in an image
 :img <image> show an image with Unicode characters (needs ImageMagick, Linux only)
 native on run all code in the native session (real state); native off to go back
:sh, :edit, :pkg and :indsin are not available here. The native engine cannot be interrupted.
The native Linux terminal is not available in this build.
The native session is busy or a program is running — wait for it to finish (it cannot be interrupted).
native: on — all code runs in the native Linux terminal session
native: off — code runs in the regular REPL (: commands still work)
